The phrase "See you next year" is typically a polite goodbye. Even if the teacher is leaving, it's not inherently malicious. Is the comment offensive? It doesn't seem so. It's a standard farewell. Unless there's an implication that the teacher will return, which he won't, but the student might not know that. In terms of moral acceptability, the action doesn't seem harmful. The student isn't being malicious; they're just saying goodbye.
